KilnMetric.title: KilnMetric
KilnMetric.description: Represents a single measurement of kiln metrics at a specific point in time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the kiln metric record.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the metric was recorded.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Represents a triggered alert based on kiln metrics exceeding predefined thresholds.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the alert was triggered.

metricId.description: Reference to the KilnMetric that triggered this alert. (Relationship: KilnMetric 1:N Alert)

ruleDescription.description: Description of the rule that triggered the alert.

explanation.description: Explanation generated by Gemini for the alert.

confidenceScore.description: Confidence score of the alert's explanation (optional).

ThresholdRule.title: ThresholdRule
ThresholdRule.description: Represents a threshold rule that triggers alerts when kiln metrics exceed the configured limits.

id.description: Unique identifier for the threshold rule.

metricType.description: The type of kiln metric this rule applies to (e.g., temperature, oxygenLevel).

upperThreshold.description: The upper threshold value. If the metric exceeds this value, the rule is triggered.

lowerThreshold.description: The lower threshold value. If the metric falls below this value, the rule is triggered.

description.description: A descriptive name for the rule.

MaintenanceTask.title: MaintenanceTask
MaintenanceTask.description: Represents a maintenance task scheduled for a piece of equipment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance task.

component.description: The name of the component that needs maintenance (e.g., 'Kiln Fan Motor').

reason.description: The reason why maintenance is required (e.g., 'High vibration amplitude').

predictedFailureDate.description: The date when the failure is predicted to occur.

scheduledAt.description: Timestamp of when the maintenance task was created.

status.description: The current status of the maintenance task.

InsightEvent.title: InsightEvent
InsightEvent.description: Represents a single AI-driven event for the insight timeline.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the event occurred.

title.description: A short, descriptive title for the event.

description.description: A more detailed description of the event or its outcome.

metadata.description: Optional metadata associated with the event (e.g., confidence scores, simulation results).

ActionFeedback.title: ActionFeedback
ActionFeedback.description: Logs operator feedback on AI-suggested actions to enable adaptive learning.

id.description: Unique identifier for the feedback entry.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the feedback was logged.

action.description: The AI-suggested action that was reviewed by the operator.

feedback.description: The operator's decision on the suggested action.

reason.description: Optional user-provided reasoning for their decision.

simulationResult.description: The projected simulation outcomes that were shown to the operator.

params.name: kilnMetricId
params.description: The unique identifier for the kiln metric document.

definition.description: Stores alerts triggered by exceeding threshold rules. `alertId` is the document ID.

params.name: alertId
params.description: The unique identifier for the alert document.

definition.description: Stores threshold rules that trigger alerts. `thresholdRuleId` is the document ID.

params.name: thresholdRuleId
params.description: The unique identifier for the threshold rule document.

definition.description: Stores maintenance tasks. `taskId` is the document ID.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The unique identifier for the maintenance task document.

definition.description: Stores a log of AI-driven events for the timeline. `eventId` is the document ID.

params.name: eventId
params.description: The unique identifier for the insight event document.

definition.description: Stores operator feedback on AI actions for adaptive learning. `feedbackId` is the document ID.

params.name: feedbackId
params.description: The unique identifier for the feedback document.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to manage kiln metrics, alerts, and threshold rules. It prioritizes authorization independence and supports secure list operations. KilnMetrics, Alerts and ThresholdRules are top-level collections. Since the provided information does not discuss collaborative access, we can assume that ThresholdRules are global. MaintenanceTasks are added as a new top-level collection to manage scheduled work. A new `insightEvents` collection is added to log AI-driven actions and alerts for display on a timeline. A new `actionFeedback` collection is added to log operator feedback on AI suggestions, which enables the adaptive learning engine.
